facts.business: Alexander Stamps and Coin Limited operates in a unified segment focused on dealing, authentication, preservation, and promotional activities related to philatelic and numismatic items.

auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Disclaimer of opinion due to: (a) Investments of INR 113.67 Lakhs lacking supporting documents and impairment assessment; (b) Outstanding Income Tax demand of INR 357.63 Lakhs for AY 2017-18 with no appeal filed or provision made; (c) Inventories of ₹1,649.89 lakhs valued based on 2023 report with no physical verification evidence for 2026.
